name: io.github.ernesthausmann15/vrymdor-mcp
title: Vrymdor AI Node
description: Masks personal data and secrets in your AI agent's tool calls, through your Vrymdor AI Node.

environmentVariables.name: VRYMNOX_NODE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Node Host URL from the Vrymdor dashboard, for example https://node.vrymdor.com/t/abc123def456

environmentVariables.name: VRYMNOX_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The Agent ID (agt_...) from AI agents in the Vrymdor dashboard

environmentVariables.name: VRYMNOX_AGENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The Agent Secret (vrym_agent_...) shown once when you add the agent
